name: Anilopam
summary: Anilopam (INN; PR 786-723) is an opioid analgesic of the benzazepine class which was developed by Pentwell in the 1960s, but it was never marketed.

uses.text: Anilopam (INN; PR 786-723) is an opioid analgesic of the benzazepine class which was developed by Pentwell in the 1960s, but it was never marketed.

fact.en: It belongs to the benzazepine class, the same ring system as nefopam, a painkiller that works without acting on opioid receptors.
fact.zh: 它屬於苯并氮䓬類，與不作用於鴉片受體的止痛藥 nefopam 擁有相同的環系。
fact.zhHans: 它属于苯并氮䓬类，与不作用于鸦片受体的止痛药 nefopam 拥有相同的环系。
